provenance.purpose: Control arm for the mined experiment. Decontaminated but C/C++ only: this is the v1 recipe with content-level held-out exclusion applied and NOTHING else changed. Isolates decontamination from the volume, compute and language changes that v3 carries.
provenance.cells: 541 per (gold x net-sign) cell, down from 552 in the published v1 set because 129 held-out content twins and 112 in-pool content duplicates were removed
provenance.DECONTAMINATED: Verified 0 v4 content leaks and 0 internal content duplicates by scripts/audit_training_pool_contamination.py (reports/decontamination_verification.json). The published v1 sets carried 32 (seed 7) and 36 (seed 123) content twins of v4 evaluation pairs.
provenance.ISOLATES: v2 vs v1 = decontamination alone (2164 vs 2208 pairs, 1082 vs 1104 steps, both 100 percent C/C++). v3 vs v2 = added volume + 46 percent more steps + the language shift. Together the two comparisons bracket what mining bought.
provenance.CAVEAT_crossvul: CrossVul non-held-out pairs are training data, as in every balanced run.
